title: Model Serving API Compiler
description: Compiles model serving APIs (FastAPI/Flask). Enforces Pydantic input validation, typed response schemas, model loaded once at startup, health endpoint, proper error handling, structured logging, latency SLA contract, and no silent failures.

error_codes.SA002: Request body not validated (no Pydantic BaseModel or marshmallow schema)
error_codes.SA003: Response not typed (response_model not set in FastAPI / no schema on output)
error_codes.SA005: Model loaded inside request handler — must load once at startup (global/lifespan)
error_codes.SA006: Bare except or no HTTP error handlers defined
error_codes.SA007: print() used instead of logging in serving API
error_codes.SA008: No latency SLA documented in spec (max_latency_ms)
